body:
Our class is reading a three-chapter story together: "The Clocktower Key."

Ivy has just moved to the town of Millbrook, where the clock in the town square has said 3:15 for twenty years. When she finds an old brass key under a floorboard, she sets out to discover what it opens, and her grumpy neighbor seems to know more than he says.

As you read, keep track of:
- the setting: where and when the story happens,
- the narrator: who is telling the story, and how you know,
- the characters: what they say, do and feel, and how they change.

Then you will become the author, and write a narrative of your own.
title: The Clocktower Key
